5.1.1.1 The ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall allow the STM to communicate with the following functions: a) DMI b) STM Control c) Reference Time d) BIU e) TIU f) Juridical Data g) Odometer Driver DMI ERTMS/ETCS On-board FFFIS STM Radio Transmission STM Sync And Reference Time Refe F r u e n n c c t e io C n lock DMI Function Tran L s o m o i p s sion Balise DMI Data Transmission STM Control Function Data ST F M un C c o tio n n trol Supervision Function Odometer Data O F d u o n m ct e io te n r Juridical Data Brake Interface Data Train Interface Data Juridical Data Function TIU Function BIU Function National FIS TI FIS JR Trackside Figure 1 – General configuration of STM and ERTMS/ETCS on-board

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2, PDF p.34

5.2 Data and ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.1.1, PDF p.34

5.2.1.1 The following paragraphs describe the ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions that are available for STM and the data that shall be transmitted over the interface.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.1.2, PDF p.34

5.2.1.2 The data is transmitted over the STM bus using Multicast or Point-to-Point Connections, see chapter 6.5.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.2.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.2.1, PDF p.35

5.2.2.1 ERTMS/ETCS on-board is responsible for providing common reference time to all connected STMs. This is defined in [2].

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.3.1, PDF p.35

5.2.3.1 Odometry data & parameters shall be sent by the ERTMS/ETCS on-board to all STMs using multicast messages.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.4, PDF p.35

5.2.4 Train Interface (TIU)

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.4.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.4.1, PDF p.35

5.2.4.1 A subset of the train interface signals specified in [6], command and status / availability are transmitted via the FFFIS STM. These train interface signals transmitted via the FFFIS STM are called Train Interface FFFIS STM signals.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.4.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.4.2, PDF p.35

5.2.4.2 The TIU Function is described as the exchange of information between the train interface and the STM, in this case: a) Status: is functional information coming from the train interface to the STM, b) Command: is functional information coming from the STM to the train interface.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.4.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.4.3, PDF p.35

5.2.4.3 Train Interface FFFIS STM command signals shall be: Command signal Description Regenerative Brake To allow or to suppress the use of the Regenerative Brake. Magnetic Shoe Brake To allow or to suppress the use of the Magnetic Shoes Brake. Eddy Current Brake for Service Brake To allow or to suppress the use of the Eddy Current Brake for Service Brake. Eddy Current Brake for Emergency Brake To allow or to suppress the use of the Eddy Current Brake for Emergency Brake. Pantograph Lower or raise the Pantograph Air Tightness Open or close air flaps Main Switch / Circuit Breaker Open or close the Main Switch / Circuit Breaker. This is considered as only one command. Traction Cut Off Cut off or not the traction

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.4.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.4.3.1, PDF p.35

5.2.4.3.1 Note: Service and Emergency Brake commands are handled in the BIU interface see chapter 5.2.5.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.4.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.4.4, PDF p.35

5.2.4.4 Train Interface FFFIS STM status signals shall be: Status signal Description Traction status Specifies the status of the traction power Direction Controller information Specifies the position of the direction controller Cab Status Specifies the active cab

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.4.4.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.4.4.1, PDF p.35

5.2.4.4.1 Note: Service and Emergency Brake status are handled in the BIU interface see chapter 5.2.5.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.5

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.5, PDF p.35

5.2.5 Brake Interface (BIU)

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.5.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.5.1, PDF p.36

5.2.5.1 The Brake Interface via ETCS is formally a part of the Train Interface. It shall include the brake interface parameters, command and status / availability of the Emergency Brake access and the Service Brake access.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.5.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.5.2, PDF p.36

5.2.5.2 Note: The BIU Function is separated from the TIU Function to allow physical separation and different safety and performance levels between brake commands/status and other commands/status on the Train Interface.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.5.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.5.3, PDF p.36

5.2.5.3 The brake status gives the availability of the brake command.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.6.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.6.1, PDF p.36

5.2.6.1 The FFFIS STM shall offer the possibility to the STM to transmit the national juridical data to be forwarded (together with the ETCS data) to the On-Board Recording Device.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7, PDF p.36

5.2.7 STM Control Function

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.1, PDF p.36

5.2.7.1 The STM Control Function shall control the STM state and the compatibility of the ERTMS/ETCS on-board and STM versions.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.2, PDF p.36

5.2.7.2 The STM Control Function shall handle the transmission of the ETCS data for STM and of the Specific NTC Data Entry/Data View for STM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.3, PDF p.36

5.2.7.3 The STM Control Function shall handle the transmission of the ETCS status data for STM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.4, PDF p.36

5.2.7.4 The STM Control Function shall handle the transmission of the language used to display information to the driver.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.5

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.5, PDF p.36

5.2.7.5 The STM Control Function shall handle the test procedure for STMs.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.6

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.6, PDF p.36

5.2.7.6 The STM Control Function shall handle the Override procedure for STMs.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.7

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.7, PDF p.36

5.2.7.7 The STM Control Function shall handle the airgap data to be transmitted to an NTC.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.8

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.8, PDF p.36

5.2.7.8 The STM Control Function shall handle STM max speed and STM system speed/distance.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.9

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.9, PDF p.36

5.2.7.9 The STM Control Function shall handle the transmission of the bus address, safety level and availability of the ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.10

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.10, PDF p.36

5.2.7.10 The STM Control Function shall handle the display of STM failure status.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.11

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.11, PDF p.36

5.2.7.11 The STM Control Function shall handle the transmission of the active Interface 'K' Antenna/BTM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.7.12

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.7.12, PDF p.36

5.2.7.12 The STM control function shall handle the transmission of the BTM alarm data.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.2.8.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.2.8.1, PDF p.36

5.2.8.1 The DMI Function shall allow an active STM to dialogue with the driver for what regards its default window (see [9] chapter 9). This includes:

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 3.2.0

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 3.2.0, PDF p.36

3.2.0 FFFIS a) Management of buttons, b) Management of indicators, c) Management of sounds, d) Management of text messages, e) Management of supervision information

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.3, PDF p.37

5.3 ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions and resources available for STMs

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.3.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.3.1.1, PDF p.37

5.3.1.1 The ERTMS/ETCS on-board shall allow the STM to access its functions and resources according to the following table: a) x = access is allowed in all Levels b) (x) = access is allowed in all Levels if possible c) s = access is only allowed for an active STM (see chapter 4.1.1.3) d) h = access is allowed for an STM in HS for preliminary request for DMI objects (see 13.2.1.5) ERTMS/ETCS ON-BOARD N S P S F L S O S N U T P S I S R functions and resources P B S H S S R S L L N R T F S N V available for STMs STM Control Function x x x x x x x x x x x x x x Reference Time x x x x x x x x x x x x x x DMI Function h h h h h s, h h h s, h h Juridical Data x x x x x x x x x x x x (x) x x Odometer Function x x x x x x x x x x x x x x TIU command (Train Interface s s s FFFIS STM signals) TIU status (Train Interface FFFIS x x x x x x x x x x x x x x STM signals) BIU command s BIU status x x x x x x x x x x x x x x

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 5.3.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 5.3.1.2, PDF p.37

5.3.1.2 When an ERTMS/ETCS on-board function fails, it shall isolate itself from the bus and shall try to close the connection with the STM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.1.1, PDF p.38

6.1.1.1 The bus used for the interface between STM and ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions shall be the PROFIBUS, defined by [5].

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.1.2, PDF p.38

6.1.1.2 The PROFIBUS protocol is used up to the FDL layer.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.1.2.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.1.2.1, PDF p.38

6.1.1.2.1 Note: The use of the FDL layer is specified in [3], chapter 4.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.1.3, PDF p.38

6.1.1.3 The bus configuration parameters for the PROFIBUS shall be: a) Baud Rate: 1500 Kbps b) Minimum Station Delay of Responders (min TSDR): 11 tBit c) Maximum Station Delay of Responders (max TSDR): 150 tBit d) Slot Time (TSL): 300 tBit e) Quiet Time (TQUI): 0 tBit f) Setup Time (TSET): 1 tBit g) Time Target Rotation (TTR): 30000 tBit (20 ms) h) GAP Actualisation Factor (G): 10 i) Highest Station Address (HSA): 126 j) Max Retry Limit (max_retry_limit): 1

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.1.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.1.3.1, PDF p.38

6.1.1.3.1 Note: This allows for a maximum permissible line length (PROFIBUS length) of 200 m per segment and a maximum number of 32 stations when using cable type A. In case a greater length or more stations are required, repeaters can be used without changing the configuration.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.1.3.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.1.3.2, PDF p.38

6.1.1.3.2 Note: PROFIBUS may also be used for other communications than the one between STM and ERTMS/ETCS on-board specified in this FFFIS STM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.2, PDF p.38

6.1.2 Physical connection

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.2.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.2.1, PDF p.38

6.1.2.1 The default physical medium shall be RS-485 twisted pair shielded copper cable.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.2.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.2.2, PDF p.38

6.1.2.2 The default connectors of the different equipments (ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions and STMs) shall be 9-pin female D-SUB and cabling according to PROFIBUS specifications.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.3, PDF p.38

6.1.3 Bus redundancy and retransmission

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.3.1, PDF p.38

6.1.3.1 Retransmission is specified in [3]

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.3.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.3.2, PDF p.38

6.1.3.2 Regarding bus redundancy, the STM and ERTMS/ETCS on-board shall have at least one bus interface each, and may have two interfaces.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.3.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.3.3, PDF p.39

6.1.3.3 In case STM and ERTMS/ETCS on-board do not have the same number of buses, only one bus shall be connected.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.1.3.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.1.3.4, PDF p.39

6.1.3.4 The dual bus configuration shall be managed by the “Redundancy Supervisor” see Ref.: [3].

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.2.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.2.1.1, PDF p.39

6.2.1.1 To allow communication between different equipment with different Safety Integrity Levels (SIL), the FFFIS STM shall provide communication with three levels of safety protocol (SL): a) Safety Level 4 (SL 4) b) Safety Level 2 (SL 2) c) Safety Level 0 (SL 0)

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.2.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.2.1.1.1, PDF p.39

6.2.1.1.1 Justification: According to the requirements for Safety-related communication in transmission systems (see [8]), an equipment with no or a low Safety Integrity Level shall not masquerade as an equipment with a higher Safety Integrity Level. This requirement shall be fulfilled by using the defined Safety Levels.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.2.1.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.2.1.1.2, PDF p.39

6.2.1.1.2 Note: The three levels of safety are specified in [3] and [2].

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.2.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.2.1.2, PDF p.39

6.2.1.2 No equipment shall implement any Safety Level corresponding to a higher Safety Integrity Level (SIL).

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.2.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.2.1.3, PDF p.39

6.2.1.3 ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions shall implement all the safety protocols up to the Safety Level (SL) corresponding to the SIL of the function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.3, PDF p.39

6.3 On-board Architecture

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.3.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.3.1.1, PDF p.39

6.3.1.1 Each STM shall only have one physical bus address (Station/Node address) towards the ERTMS/ETCS on-board.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.3.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.3.1.2, PDF p.39

6.3.1.2 The ERTMS/ETCS on-board may use one or several physical bus addresses depending on its architecture.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.3.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.3.1.3, PDF p.39

6.3.1.3 An STM shall be able to handle one different physical address for each ERTMS/ETCS on-board function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.3.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.3.1.4, PDF p.39

6.3.1.4 In case several STMs share the same physical address, each of them shall establish its own connection at Application Layer using different NID_STMs.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.4, PDF p.39

6.4 Physical Addressing (Station/Nodes addresses)

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.4.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.4.1.1, PDF p.39

6.4.1.1 The physical addresses shall be allocated according to the following table.

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 3.2.0, PDF p.39

3.2.0 FFFIS Physical Address Device 2 STM Control Function 0, 1, 2, 3.. 19 Other ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions 20.. 49 Unused by FFFIS STM 50.. 69 STM configurable addresses range 70.. 126 STMs (NID_NTC+70) 127 Reserved for Broadcast and Multicast

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.4.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.4.1.2, PDF p.40

6.4.1.2 By default the Physical address of an STM shall be the NID_NTC value + 70.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.4.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.4.1.3, PDF p.40

6.4.1.3 STM configurable addresses range shall be used for STMs for which the sum of NID_STM value +70 goes out of the Profibus physical address range

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.4.1.4, PDF p.40

6.4.1.4 In case several STMs share the same physical address, the address value shall be the one of any of the supported STMs or a configurable physical address.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.4.1.5

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.4.1.5, PDF p.40

6.4.1.5 When a physical address in the STM configurable addresses range is to be used, it shall be possible to configure the value of this physical address in order to solve any potential address conflicts.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.5.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.5.1.1, PDF p.40

6.5.1.1 The FFFIS STM requires communication with different functions of the ERTMS/ETCS on-board as e. g. Odometer, DMI and Juridical Data.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.5.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.5.1.2, PDF p.40

6.5.1.2 The FFFIS STM shall use Service Access Points (SAPs) to support communication between STMs and the different ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.5.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.5.1.3, PDF p.40

6.5.1.3 All ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions shall have a defined fixed SAP.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.5.1.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.5.1.3.1, PDF p.40

6.5.1.3.1 Note: The SAP is fixed regardless of the chosen physical address.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 6.5.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 6.5.1.4, PDF p.40

6.5.1.4 For transmitting data between ERTMS/ETCS on-board and the STMs, the local (Source) Service Access Point (SSAP) and partner (Destination) Service Access Point (DSAP) shall have the same value.

3.2.0 FFFIS 7. CONNECTION MANAGEMENT AND VERSION CHECK

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1, PDF p.43

7.1 General requirements linked to the opening of point-to-point connection between STM and ERTMS/ETCS on-board

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.1, PDF p.43

7.1.1 Opening of the connection

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.1.1, PDF p.43

7.1.1.1 A connection shall be considered as established when the version check is considered as completed and successful (see chapter 7.1.2).

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.1.2, PDF p.43

7.1.1.2 The STM shall take the initiative to establish the connection.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.1.3, PDF p.43

7.1.1.3 When a STM has to establish a connection with an ERTMS/ETCS on-board function, and fails to establish the connection 2 times, it shall be allowed to retry the establishment of connection after 10 seconds.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.2.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.2.1, PDF p.43

7.1.2.1 Each time the STM opens a connection with any ERTMS/ETCS on-board function, the STM shall send its “FFFIS STM version number” to this ERTMS/ETCS on-board function, followed by the STM state report information in the same application message.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.2.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.2.2, PDF p.43

7.1.2.2 When receiving the “FFFIS STM version number” from the STM, the concerned ERTMS/ETCS on-board function shall check the version compatibility as follows: a) if the “FFFIS STM version number X” from the STM is lower than the lowest “FFFIS STM version number X” supported by the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board function shall close the connection (final disconnection on Safety Layers). b) if the “FFFIS STM version number X” from the STM is amongst the ones supported by the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board function shall send to the STM the highest supported FFFIS STM version number of which the version number X is equal to the one received from the STM. The ERTMS/ETCS on- board function shall be allowed to transmit application data to the STM. c) if the “FFFIS STM version number X” from the STM is greater than the highest version number X supported by the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board function shall close the connection (final disconnection).

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.2.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.2.3, PDF p.43

7.1.2.3 When receiving “FFFIS STM version number” from ERTMS/ETCS on-board, the STM shall check the version compatibility. If it is compatible with the “FFFIS STM version number” of the STM, then the version check is considered as terminated and successful. The STM shall be allowed to transmit further application data to the ERTMS/ETCS on-board function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.2.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.2.4, PDF p.43

7.1.2.4 If the “FFFIS STM version number” of the ERTMS/ETCS on-board is not compatible with the “FFFIS STM version number” of the STM, then the STM shall close the connection (final disconnection) to the concerned ERTMS/ETCS on-board function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.3, PDF p.44

7.1.3 Closing of the connection

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.3.1, PDF p.44

7.1.3.1 Closing a connection on application layer shall be done by requesting the Safety Layers (see 6.6.1.2) to close the connection.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.1.4, PDF p.44

7.1.4 Connection Sequence Charts. STM ETCS Safety Layer connection Net Data message: Version number Connection established Connection Net Data message: Version number for ETCS established for STM Other Net Data Messages Safety Layer disconnection Figure 4 Nominal connection establishment sequence chart STM ETCS Safety Layer connection Net Data message: Version number Connection rejected by ETCS Safety Layer disconnection Figure 5 Bad version number disconnection sequence chart

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.2, PDF p.44

7.2 General requirements linked to handling multicast connection

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.2.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.2.1.1, PDF p.45

7.2.1.1 The multicast sender shall open a separate connection for all “FFFIS STM version numbers” defined in the Legal backward compatibility envelope (see table 16.3.1.1).

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.2.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.2.1.2, PDF p.45

7.2.1.2 Note: For each multicast application connection (currently limited to Odometer Function), the table 6.5.1.5 contains one SAP for each “FFFIS STM version number”. This allows opening separate connections.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.2.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.2.1.3, PDF p.45

7.2.1.3 On each connection, the multicast sender shall transmit the corresponding “FFFIS STM version number” over the FFFIS STM. The transmission shall be repeated to support restarting STMs.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.2.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.2.1.4, PDF p.45

7.2.1.4 When receiving “FFFIS STM version number” from ERTMS/ETCS on-board, the STM shall check the version compatibility.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 7.2.1.5

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 7.2.1.5, PDF p.45

7.2.1.5 If the “FFFIS STM version number” of the ERTMS/ETCS on-board is not compatible with the “FFFIS STM version number” of the STM, then the STM shall ignore any information received from this multicast connection.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 3.2.0

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 3.2.0, PDF p.45

3.2.0 FFFIS 8. STM STATES

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.1.1.1, PDF p.46

8.1.1.1 The NP state means that the STM is unpowered.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.2.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.2.1.1, PDF p.46

8.2.1.1 This state is the default state entered by the STM after the STM is switched on.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.2.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.2.1.2, PDF p.46

8.2.1.2 Once in PO state, the STM shall perform the synchronisation of the Safe Time Layer.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.2.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.2.1.3, PDF p.46

8.2.1.3 Once in PO state, the STM shall establish a connection with the ERTMS/ETCS on- board STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.2.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.2.1.4, PDF p.46

8.2.1.4 When the STM has established the connection to the STM Control Function, the STM shall send a “Specific NTC Data Need” information to the STM Control Function indicating whether it needs or not Specific NTC Data.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.2.1.5

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.2.1.5, PDF p.46

8.2.1.5 Once the ERTMS/ETCS on-board has sent the bus addresses and safety levels of all available ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions (see 10.1.1.4), it shall allow STM to establish connections with any of these functions.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.2.1.6

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.2.1.6, PDF p.46

8.2.1.6 Once the STM Control Function has sent the ETCS status data to an STM in PO state (see chapter 10.5.1.1), it shall allow this STM to request CO state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.1, PDF p.46

8.3.1.1 The STM CO state is used to wait until all configuration data between STM and ERTMS/ETCS on-board have been exchanged. “Configuration data” means data that is necessary for the national operation, except Specific NTC Data.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.2, PDF p.46

8.3.1.2 Configuration data from ERTMS/ETCS on-board to STMs consists of: a) ETCS data (see chapter 10.4) b) Status / availability of the train interface FFFIS STM signals (TIU) c) Status / availability of the brake interface FFFIS STM signals (BIU) d) Odometer performance parameters (see chapter 12.4) e) Brake performance parameters: Maximum time delay for the ERTMS/ETCS on-board to process the STM Emergency and the STM Service Brake commands. This is the time from receiving the brake command from the STM until the ETCS commands the brake.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.2.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.2.1, PDF p.46

8.3.1.2.1 Note: Configuration data has not necessarily to be sent in CO state. Some data could be sent in PO state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.2.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.2.2, PDF p.46

8.3.1.2.2 Note: The brake performance parameter can be used by the STM in braking curves calculation.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.3, PDF p.47

8.3.1.3 Once the transmission of configuration data is finished and the Specific NTC Data Entry procedure is started, if the STM does not require any Specific NTC Data, then the STM shall request Cold Standby state to the STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.4, PDF p.47

8.3.1.4 If an STM in Configuration State detects that the ERTMS/ETCS on-board is in the mode Non-Leading or Sleeping and has received all the configuration data except for the ETCS data, the STM shall request to go to Cold Standby state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.4.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.4.1, PDF p.47

8.3.1.4.1 Justification: This allows STM operation in Non-Leading or Sleeping in which ETCS Train Data is not available.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.5

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.5, PDF p.47

8.3.1.5 Once the transmission of configuration data is finished and the Specific NTC Data Entry procedure is started, if the STM does require any Specific NTC Data, then the STM shall request Data Entry state to the STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.3.1.6

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.3.1.6, PDF p.47

8.3.1.6 When an STM exits CO state, it shall have the possibility to close any connection except with STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.4.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.4.1.1, PDF p.47

8.4.1.1 The state DE is used by any STM that requires Specific NTC Data in order to have all the required national information for operating the train with the STM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.4.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.4.1.1.1, PDF p.47

8.4.1.1.1 Note: This state is only entered once at the start up process of the STM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.4.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.4.1.2, PDF p.47

8.4.1.2 In the state DE, the Specific NTC Data Entry procedure (see chapter 10.7) shall be performed.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.4.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.4.1.3, PDF p.47

8.4.1.3 Once the Specific NTC Data Entry procedure is terminated, the STM shall request Cold Standby state to the STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.4.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.4.1.4, PDF p.47

8.4.1.4 Note: The Specific NTC Data Entry procedure can be terminated without having received the Specific NTC Data (e.g. when the Specific NTC Data Entry procedure is skipped). However, the Cold Standby state is still requested in order to have the same system behaviour when the Specific NTC Data is invalid.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.5.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.5.1.1, PDF p.47

8.5.1.1 Being in the state CS, the STM has been initialised, tested (if required), configured and is in possession of all required information for operating, but is not able to receive a message from the trackside, because the reception is turned off.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.5.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.5.1.1.1, PDF p.47

8.5.1.1.1 Exception: Specific NTC Data could be invalid, see 10.7.3.3.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.6.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.6.1.1, PDF p.47

8.6.1.1 Being in the state HS, the STM shall be able to process the information from or to the national trackside.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.6.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.6.1.1.1, PDF p.48

8.6.1.1.1 Note: In HS state, when receiving national trackside information, the STM treats this information to be prepared to take charge of the train movement supervision once it switches to Data Available state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.6.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.6.1.2, PDF p.48

8.6.1.2 The STM in HS state shall have the possibility to send an “STM max speed” (V_STMMAX) to the ERTMS/ETCS on-board through the STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.6.1.2.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.6.1.2.1, PDF p.48

8.6.1.2.1 Note: This “STM max speed” is to allow the STM, for national reasons unknown to the ERTMS/ETCS on-board or ETCS Trackside, to request a given train speed at the level transition border in order to have a smooth transition.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.6.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.6.1.3, PDF p.48

8.6.1.3 The STM in HS shall have the possibility to send an “STM system speed” (V_STMSYS) together with an “STM system distance” (D_STMSYS) to the ERTMS/ETCS on-board through the STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.6.1.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.6.1.3.1, PDF p.48

8.6.1.3.1 Note: This “STM system speed” together with the “STM system distance” is sent to allow the STM, to request a given train speed at a given position (“STM system distance”) before the level transition border in order to be able to detect its national trackside.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.6.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.6.1.4, PDF p.48

8.6.1.4 When an STM in HS state receives an order to go in CS state, the STM shall have the possibility to close any connection except with STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.7.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.7.1.1, PDF p.48

8.7.1.1 In DA state, an STM is responsible for the train movement supervision, according to the received national trackside information.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.7.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.7.1.2, PDF p.48

8.7.1.2 When an STM in DA state receives an order to go in CS state, the STM shall have the possibility to close any connection except with STM Control Function.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.8.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.8.1.1, PDF p.48

8.8.1.1 Being in this state, the STM is not able to work any more, due to internal or external reasons.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 8.8.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 8.8.1.2, PDF p.48

8.8.1.2 Being in this state, the STM shall not send messages any more on the bus except to report this state to the ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 3.2.0

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 3.2.0, PDF p.48

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.1.1.1, PDF p.49

9.1.1.1 The scope of this chapter is to define how the STM handles its state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 9.2.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.2.1.3, PDF p.50

9.2.1.3 Note: As long as an STM in DA state is in a National Trip Procedure in SN mode, the STM sends cyclically the “National Trip Procedure” information to the STM Control Function in order to fulfil the timeout requirements defined in 10.3.2.4 (transitions E16 and F16). If the mode changes to TR, the STM is expected to enter CS state even if its National Trip Procedure is not finished, as the Trip procedure is handed over by ERTMS/ETCS on-board (otherwise, the STM would be ordered to FA state through transition Q16 once the TR mode is exited).

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 9.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.3, PDF p.50

9.3 General STM requirements

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 9.3.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.3.1.1, PDF p.50

9.3.1.1 The STM antenna shall not energise trackside equipment, and shall not read trackside data, and shall not transmit data to trackside, except: a) in HS or DA state, b) for test purpose.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 9.3.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.3.1.2, PDF p.50

9.3.1.2 If the STM receives from the ERTMS/ETCS on-board a state transition order, which is not allowed by the state transition table (9.2.1.2), then the STM shall go in FA state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 9.3.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.3.1.3, PDF p.50

9.3.1.3 The STM shall report its NID_STM on all point-to-point connections with the ERTMS/ETCS on-board: a) intentionally deleted b) with each transmitted application message from the STM to the ERTMS/ETCS on- board function or DMI channel.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 9.3.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.3.1.4, PDF p.50

9.3.1.4 The STM shall report its current state on all point-to-point connections with the ERTMS/ETCS on-board: a) intentionally deleted b) with each transmitted application message from the STM to the ERTMS/ETCS on- board function or DMI channel, and c) whenever the STM state is changed, while the connection to the respective ERTMS/ETCS on-board function or DMI channel is established.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 9.3.1.4.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 9.3.1.4.1, PDF p.51

9.3.1.4.1 Exception: The FA state shall be reported if possible. Due to a failure of the STM itself it may not be possible to report the FA state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 3.2.0

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 3.2.0, PDF p.51

3.2.0 FFFIS 10. STM CONTROL FUNCTION

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.1, PDF p.52

10.1 General requirements

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.1.1.1, PDF p.52

10.1.1.1 It shall be possible to configure the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment with the list of STMs installed on-board.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.1.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.1.1.2, PDF p.52

10.1.1.2 The STM Control Function shall maintain a list of “available” STMs, which includes all STMs that have an established connection to the STM Control Function and report either CS, HS or DA state.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.1.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.1.1.3, PDF p.52

10.1.1.3 Level NTC X shall be considered as “Available for use” for level transition (see [1] paragraph 5.10.2.4.1) if the STM X associated to this level is available.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.1.1.4

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.1.1.4, PDF p.52

10.1.1.4 The STM Control Function shall send to the STM the following information when the connection to the STM is established: a) The ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions that are available b) The ETCS bus address of all available ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions c) The safety level of all available ERTMS/ETCS on-board functions (see 6.2)

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.1.1.4.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.1.1.4.1, PDF p.52

10.1.1.4.1 Note: Only Juridical Data and DMI channels 2, 3 & 4 can be marked as not available.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.1.1.5

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.1.1.5, PDF p.52

10.1.1.5 The STM Control Function shall inform the STM about the active DMI channel a) whenever the active DMI channel changes, b) whenever the connection to STM Control Function is established.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.2, PDF p.52

10.2 Association of STM X to Level NTC X

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.2.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.2.1.1, PDF p.52

10.2.1.1 The ERTMS/ETCS on-board shall be configurable with a look-up table that gives the correspondence between NID_NTC values and the NID_STM values of the STM(s) fitted on-board. For each NID_NTC value within this look-up table, a list of one or several NID_STM values shall be configured, with a priority order.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.2.1.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.2.1.1.1, PDF p.52

10.2.1.1.1 Note: A National System can cover the functionalities of other National Systems having their own NID_NTC values. For that case, the look-up table is needed to map the NID_NTC values corresponding to these encapsulated National Systems to the NID_STM value(s) of the STM(s) fitted on-board supporting them. But an entry in the look-up table is not needed for the case there is a one-to-one relation between NID_NTC value and NID_STM value.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.2.1.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.2.1.1.2, PDF p.52

10.2.1.1.2 Throughout this document, “STM X” stands for “STM associated to Level NTC X”. This STM is not necessarily fitted on-board.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.2.1.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.2.1.2, PDF p.52

10.2.1.2 If Level NTC X (defined by its NID_NTC) is not already associated to an STM, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board shall associate this Level NTC X to STM X as follows: a) When a level transition order to Level NTC X is accepted,

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 3.2.0

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 3.2.0, PDF p.52

3.2.0 FFFIS the STM X shall be the STM which NID_STM is equal to NID_NTC, if the level transition order is received from a trackside constituent with ETCS system version strictly lower than 2.0 or if the look-up table does not contain the NID_NTC value of Level NTC X. Otherwise the STM X shall be the STM having the highest priority among the available STMs linked to the NID_NTC value in the look-up table. If there is no available STM linked to this NID_NTC value, the STM X shall be the STM having the highest priority among the STMs linked to this NID_NTC value. b) When the ERTMS/ETCS on-board receives airgap data to be transmitted to an STM with the NID_NTC value of Level NTC X, the STM X shall be associated as for the level transition. c) When the Level NTC X is selected/validated by driver, the STM X shall be the STM which NID_STM is equal to NID_NTC, if the look-up table does not contain the NID_NTC value of Level NTC X. Otherwise, the STM X shall be the STM having the highest priority among the available STMs linked to this NID_NTC value in the look-up table. If there is no available STM linked to this NID_NTC value, then the STM X shall be the STM having the highest priority among the connected STMs linked to this NID_NTC value and that are not considered as failed or seen as isolated. Otherwise, the STM X shall be the STM having the highest priority among the STMs linked to this NID_NTC value.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.2.1.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.2.1.3, PDF p.53

10.2.1.3 The association between a Level NTC X and an STM X shall be kept until the Level NTC X is left after having been entered, or until the Stand-By or No Power mode is entered.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.2.1.3.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.2.1.3.1, PDF p.53

10.2.1.3.1 Note: If STM X associated to the current Level NTC X is no more available, it remains associated to Level NTC X until one of these conditions is fulfilled, even if another STM supporting NTC X is available. This avoids that there is a change of active STM that is neither due to a level transition from trackside, nor due to a driver level selection/validation.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.3.1.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.3.1.1, PDF p.53

10.3.1.1 The present chapter does not specify the whole STM Control Function, but only the part of the STM Control Function that manages the states of the connected STM(s).

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.3.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.3.2, PDF p.53

10.3.2 State transition orders

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.3.2.1

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.3.2.1, PDF p.53

10.3.2.1 The STM Control Function STM state order table is a table that lists all the events that lead to a state order given by the STM Control Function to the STM.

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.3.2.2

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.3.2.2, PDF p.54

10.3.2.2 STM state order table (ERTMS/ETCS on-board STM Control Function) NP < A15 < A15 < A15 < A15 < A15 < A15 < A15 A1 > PO < A1 < A1 < A1 < A1 < A1 < A1 A2 > CO A3 > DE < C4a < B4a A4a > A4a > CS < E4a < B4b < G4a < I4a < H4a < A4b < I4a < E4a < J4a < K4a < L4a A6 > HS B6 > A9> A9 > DA A17 > A16 > A16 > A16 > A16 > A16 > A16 > FA B16 > B16 > B16 > B16 > B16 > B16 > B16> C16 > C16 > C16 > C16 > C16 > C16 > H16 > H16 > H16 > D16 > D16 > E16 > I16 > I16 > I16 > H16 > H16 > F16 > L16 > O16 > O16 > N16 > N16 > H16 > P16 > P16 > P16 > O16 > O16 > N16 > A17 > A17 > A17 > P16 > P16 > O16 > A17 > A17 > P16 > Q16> A17 >

SUBSET-035 v3.2.0 — clause 10.3.2.3

Citation: SUBSET-035 v3.2.0, clause 10.3.2.3, PDF p.54

10.3.2.3 The state indicated in table 10.3.2.2 corresponds to the last state report received from the STM or to FA state if an FA state order has been sent since the reception of the last state report. The STM Control Function shall consider the STM to be in NP when it has not received any state report from the STM.
